From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML/Infra)  60-90 min

Hi Alex 

Thanks again for the call today  really helpful to understand Acme Health Techs ingestion/PHI boundaries and the latency targets you mentioned (95th pct under 350ms for the patient-facing route). As discussed, the next best step is a technical deep dive with your ML + infra teams so we can:

- Walk through an end-to-end request path (ingest -> preprocess -> model inference -> post-processing)
- Review model compatibility and quantization constraints for your finetuned models
- Map out performance and scaling expectations (batching, KV cache sizing, token distribution)
- Align on security & network needs (VPC peering, KMS, audit/log retention)

We recommend 60	60 minutes so we can include a short demo of the Redwood runtime and then spend time on architecture questions. Proposed attendees from your side: you + Sana Patel (ML Platform) + whoever owns networking/infra. From our side: me (AE), Camila (solutions/AM), and Dylan (runtime engineer).

Here are a few times that work on our side:
- Tue Feb 16: 10:3012:00 PT
- Tue Feb 16: 14:0015:30 PT
- Wed Feb 17: 09:0010:30 PT

If none of those work, please feel free to send a few time windows or grab a slot via my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-tech-deep-dive-60-90

Attached is a draft agenda and a short checklist of artifacts that will help the session (model specs, sample payloads, current qps/token profiles).

Agenda (draft):
1) Intros & goals (510m)
2) Runtime demo & performance profile (1520m)
3) Architecture review & model compatibility discussion (2030m)
4) Scaling/network/security discussion (1520m)
5) Action items & next steps (10m)

Thanks  looking forward to the next conversation.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Attachment: redwood_tech_deep_dive_agenda.pdf
